text_block_list.text:
The public is abuzz with anticipation for 
the Arima Kinen, set to be a clash between 
Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross.

Additionally, Super Creek, whose running 
impressed with its combination of stamina 
and sharp acceleration, is also drawing 
significant attention.

Looking at her rivals, Inari One sensed 
the "fate" that brought them to the same 
track, and the "destiny" of it becoming 
one massive festival.

She can't wait to run alongside Oguri Cap 
and the others in the Senior Year, but 
before that, there's something she must 
take this year.

To enter the Senior class carrying the 
pride of the regional pinnacle, she began 
her final preparations for the Tokyo 
Daishoten.
